text: When a job is built on top of an earlier unmerged job, record the base job. After any Athena pull request merges, find the other open Athena pull requests whose commits are all now in main. Close each one with a comment naming the PR that merged, and mark its job superseded. Acceptance: a test where job B is stacked on unmerged job A shows that merging B's PR closes A's PR with a comment and sets A's job to superseded with no operator action, and that a PR with commits not yet in main stays open.
